plugins.Author: wah
plugins.Name: WahTools
plugins.Changelog:
- More UI cleanup: smaller layouts, sortable lists, adjustable detail panels, and clearer status when tours and boats are running together
- Made the overlay easier to read without losing preparation steps, counts, or timers, so waiting for a fish no longer makes it look like we’ve given up and gone Idle
- Added a fish window timer so you can keep an eye on upcoming windows and prep times
- Gave Warden a lot of attention: Fish Eyes, multi hooking, GP use, stored bait, and knowing when to catch that last Green Prismfish
- Improved several other big fish strategies and fixed cases where preparation could switch targets mid cast or forget which mooch was in progress
- Tours are more careful about leaving behind preparation you’ve already worked for
- Cleaned up the Ocean page so routes, goals, bookings, and voyage details are easier to follow
- Brought back manual boat positioning, with less wandering around the deck when using automatic positioning
- Achievement bookings now have a cancel button, party achievements can be booked individually, and voyage catch counts survive plugin reloads
- Fixed discard confirmations for unique/untradeable fish and improved protection for preparation and quest fish
- Added an option to turn in scrip fish when your bags fill, then carry on fishing
- Improved landing and stuck recovery, including fixes around Tharl Oom Khash and Cenote Moxutural
- Added resting place choices through Lifestream and colored map markers for Hunter
- Added Relic and Crystarium Deliveries filters
- Confirmed: Surface Slap slaps hard as hell
For anyone using IPC
- Breaking changes: CatchList → Catch, CancelCatch → Stop, and ReleaseAllHeldFish → ReleaseHeldFish
- CatchDone now reports the fish ID instead of an owner name
- Added Hunter IPC, with ocean settings changed through IPC restored when the activity finishes
